gates.title: Enough stations for spatially independent evaluation
gates.rule: A city needs >= 20 stations before it contributes to headline spatial metrics; smaller networks are used for training and temporal / cross-city tests only.

gates.title: No unlabeled or missing targets
gates.rule: Labels must be real observations aligned to ERA5 hours.

gates.title: Coordinates valid and consistent (WGS84 lat/lon, no swapped axes)
gates.evidence: 0 out-of-range coordinates; 0 cities with implausible spread
gates.rule: All stations must be valid WGS84 coordinates and sit within a city-sized extent.

gates.title: Surrounding land-cover fractions are valid fractions
gates.rule: Land-cover fractions derived from OSM must lie in [0, 1].

gates.title: Station elevation consistent with the ERA5 grid cell
gates.evidence: 0 stations differ by more than 400 m from the ERA5 cell elevation
gates.rule: Large elevation mismatch makes the ERA5 baseline unreliable; the model gets elev_vs_era5 as a feature.

gates.title: No co-located duplicate stations
gates.rule: Near-duplicate stations leak information across folds; spatial blocks plus a buffer absorb them.

gates.title: Held-out stations never appear in training
gates.evidence: 0 stations shared between train and test across 5 folds
gates.rule: Test stations must be disjoint from training stations.

gates.title: Spatial buffer between train and test stations
gates.rule: Every training station must be at least 0.5 km from every held-out station.

gates.title: Hyper-parameters tuned without touching test stations
gates.evidence: chosen 'medium' using an inner split of the training stations of fold 0
gates.rule: Tuning may only use inner splits of the training stations.

gates.title: Prediction intervals are calibrated out of sample
gates.rule: Nominal 80% intervals should cover 73-87% of held-out observations.

gates.title: Naive random-row validation blocked from headline results
gates.evidence: random-row RMSE 0.921 C vs spatial-block RMSE 1.088 C (15% apparent error reduction from leakage)
gates.rule: Random-row and random-station numbers are reported only as leakage evidence and are labelled not reportable.

gates.title: Production model carries an explicit scope statement
gates.evidence: model_card.json records training cities and unvalidated regimes
gates.rule: A shipped model must state where it has and has not been validated.
